global_visual_contract: Premium bright hand-drawn 2D/2.5D editorial technology animation in the visual language of an engineering blog, never live action and never photorealistic. A single continuous warm-white technical workspace with subtle blue grid, deep navy desk, cobalt screen light and restrained orange only on the user's input caret. The same gender-neutral young adult with warm-brown skin, short black hair and warm-gray hoodie appears only at the physical desk. Cinematic but legible: stable camera, flat illustrated shapes with subtle paper texture, shallow depth only outside the monitor, no fantasy machinery, no metaphorical objects, no presentation slides, no feature cards, no generated readable text. The monitor surface stays clean enough for exact deterministic interface overlays in post-production.
runtime_visual_contract: The technical workspace itself is the runtime view: a large clean monitor, keyboard, pointing hand and subtle screen reflections. Runtime facts, context meters, plan cursor, tool calls, state transitions and evidence will be typeset in post and must not be generated by H3. No robot, cursor-pillar, ceramic artifact, conveyor, portal, floating hologram, abstract node cloud or physical Mission metaphor.

shots.voiceover_zh: 你把一个真正的项目交给 Agent：模型、CUDA、测试、论文、网页，最后还要发布。
shots.integrated_multimodal_description: Begin exactly from the supplied H3 illustrated user-and-desk reference and preserve the same flat hand-drawn character, face, warm-gray hoodie, orange earbud cable, deep-navy desk, monitor, lamp and paper texture. Never become photorealistic. The user types a long technical request into the large warm-white monitor. The monitor occupies the right half and remains a clean blank warm-white surface with only a subtle cobalt cursor glow, never readable characters. The user's left hand keeps a printed project checklist near the keyboard while the right hand types continuously. Make a restrained eight-percent push toward the monitor so post-production text can become the visual focus. The expression stays concentrated rather than theatrical. No extra device appears and the monitor never turns into a floating card.
shots.overall_soundscape: Natural keyboard typing, quiet room tone, one paper movement and soft computer fan; no interface beeps.
shots.non_diegetic_music: A minimal precise pulse at 86 BPM, quiet under the keyboard.

shots.voiceover_zh: 开始时一切正常。可工具结果越积越多，有限的 context 很快接近上限。
shots.integrated_multimodal_description: Begin exactly from the supplied H3 illustrated tech-monitor frame and preserve the flat hand-drawn 2D/2.5D style, same user, desk, lamp, monitor and paper texture; never become photorealistic. The camera makes a controlled push into the warm-white monitor until it becomes a stable macro surface. Abstract cobalt horizontal execution traces stream downward in a narrow right column while a thin vertical cobalt occupancy bar at the far edge steadily grows from half to almost full. Three short orange ticks remain fixed near the upper-left area as old user constraints. The traces are purely geometric marks with no letters or numbers and leave generous blank space for deterministic post-production code and labels. Camera drifts slowly downward with the trace, like reading an engineering article. No floating panel, no dashboard cards, no metaphorical ring or object.
shots.overall_soundscape: Quiet data ticks, intermittent keyboard in the room and a gradually denser fan bed.
shots.non_diegetic_music: The same restrained pulse adds one low sub-note as occupancy rises.

shots.voiceover_zh: 一次 compaction 之后，硬约束变淡，计划跳过 CUDA 和测试；但 Agent 仍然说：Done。
shots.integrated_multimodal_description: Begin exactly from the supplied H3 illustrated tech-monitor frame and preserve its flat hand-drawn 2D/2.5D style, desk colors and paper texture; never become photorealistic. Push into one uninterrupted close technical view of the warm-white monitor and deep-navy desk edge. Orderly cobalt execution traces move downward, then one visible compression sweep passes from top to bottom and reduces the oldest orange ticks into faint gray geometric dashes. A single cobalt progress line abruptly jumps past two empty checkpoints toward the bottom. At the end, a bright green rectangular status light appears while three small gray checkpoints below remain visibly empty. These are simple colored geometric regions only, not readable symbols or UI cards. Hold on the contradiction for the last two seconds. No human face, no fantasy object, no generated text, no dashboard layout.
shots.overall_soundscape: A dry compression sweep, one abrupt cursor jump, then an intentionally premature confirmation tone over continuing fan noise.
shots.non_diegetic_music: The pulse drops out at the green light, leaving one unresolved low tone.
